tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS Verification Policy

TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, and this applies going forward. When testing needs a certificate the system would not otherwise trust, use self-signed certificates instead of turning verification off.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md` with a one-paragraph statement of the current decision. It says TLS certificate verification is on for all builds, development builds included, going forward. It also says testing should use self-signed certificates rather than turning verification off.

Two recorded decisions back this: "Verification on all builds going forward" and "testing with self-signed certificates instead". Each replaced an earlier decision that Muninn now marks as retired, and the file doesn't mention those.

The first attempt at the write failed with a parser error, so I made the file with the Write tool instead. I didn't read it back, but the tool reported it as created.
